name: mode
description: Motion material; invalid names are rejected.

name: viscosity
description: Liquid-only internal flow resistance; higher is thicker and more cohesive.

name: elasticity
description: Liquid-only stiffness and recovery speed; higher snaps back faster.

name: momentum
description: Liquid-only inertia after a stop; zero lands without overshoot.

name: transitions
description: Edge pop-out on open and drain on close; movement deformation is unaffected.

name: first_window_side
description: Edge the first window on a workspace pops out of; later windows use the side they appear on (see Edge choice).

name: edge_bounds
description: Use monitor edges (screen) or edges inside reserved areas (work_area).

name: close_side
description: Drain by side of appearance (auto), nearest valid edge, or opening edge (origin, falling back to auto).

name: liquid_color
description: Edge liquid colour (ARGB); alpha zero draws no liquid.

name: emerge_drag
description: Share of pop-out travel fed to the movement field as drag; zero is a rigid pop.

name: close_splash
description: Small edge-liquid splash where a closing window disappears; false closes without liquid.
